item.artDescription: An engraving on this weapon is shaped like an abstracted rendering of emptiness. The scene takes place on the outskirts of a village. The work is infused with the idea of tyranny and is done in a complex and realistic style.
An engraving on this weapon illustrates a lonely abstract shape. The overall composition is rectangular. As an interesting contrast, the scene takes place inside a district built near a tributary.
